prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept.
Asset: one transparent full-body 2D battle character portrait.
Input image: identity, costume and painterly style reference; replace the pose and remove its white background.
Scene: genuinely transparent RGBA background, no setting, ground plane, cast shadow, border or checkerboard artwork.
Subject: Wu, the same young adult fantasy swordswoman shown in the provided approved reference. Keep her recognizable youthful face, fair skin, vivid cyan-blue eyes, confident small-fang smile, silver-white neatly gathered very high ponytail reaching her calves with a blue satin bow, two face-framing locks, parted light bangs, matte black round sunglasses on her head, and the black rose beside the ponytail root. Keep the off-shoulder charcoal-black ruffled dress, narrow black waist belt, plain dark outer skirt and deep-blue star-patterned inner lining visible at the hem, calf-length skirt silhouette consistent with the reference, bare lower legs and black cuffed ankle boots. One single slender black longsword is now drawn in her right gloved hand; its empty black scabbard remains strapped diagonally behind her back. Her free left hand stays relaxed and ready near her waist.
Composition: A grounded battle-ready idle stance facing screen-right. Her torso, hips, face, gaze and boots turn clearly toward the RIGHT edge of the image, at a right-facing three-quarter side angle. She looks toward an opponent outside the canvas to the right. Her right boot is a little forward, knees gently flexed, weight balanced. Hold the one black sword low and forward in a controlled guard, its point toward screen-right. Make the right-facing direction unmistakable while keeping her recognizable face readable. Full body from top of ponytail to both boot soles, entire sword, hair and skirt inside the canvas, with comfortable transparent margins. One character only; no enemy or extra weapon.
Lighting/materials: Soft directional light with restrained cool gray-blue cloth shadows and precise steel highlights. Distinct matte fabric, satin ribbon, leather boots and dark metal; retain the reference painterly finish.
Style: masterpiece, best quality, painterly, sketch, visible brush strokes, loose hand-painted texture, broken edges, blocky volume modeling.

A complete illustration with the freshness of a painted sketch, not an unfinished draft. Soft directional light reveals the planes of forms. Build volumes from confident planes of light and shadow with visible brush edges, while letting selected outer contours remain open. Use broad flowing paint masses, dry uneven strokes, and crisp small highlights appropriate to each material. Vary the brush size and edge sharpness between different materials. Preserve deliberate brush marks instead of smoothing every surface.
Constraints: preserve reference identity and costume; change pose and weapon handling only as specified. No text, watermark, extra limbs or malformed fingers. Do not redesign her outfit or lengthen the skirt.
